rule: Every canonical GMV round and news record must use the fixed vocabulary/scales and preserve legacy source material in explicit migration metadata; missing source values remain null and are never invented.
exact_quantity_rule: Exact quantities remain exact quantities with explicit units.
chronology_rule: Historical round records are immutable outcomes; migration changes representation, not events or outcomes.
validation_rule: A canonical round that violates this contract must not advance the canonical pointer.
migration_note: Rounds already normalized to gmv-round-v2 are retained; legacy source material is preserved under migration/legacy_record fields rather than rewritten as new history.
